# E1_ensemble (generated by scripts/ensemble.py)

Weighted average of the members' curves, weights >= 0 summing to 1, fitted to minimise EMD on the OOF curves of
repeat 0 (an exact linear programme). The honest CV fits the weights of each fold on the other 5 folds.

| S1_mae_frozen                          | 35.33 |  46.47 |  45.19 |    22.87 |
| V7_own_vit_small_augreg_head           | 39.75 |  46.09 |  46.12 |    32.25 |
| T1_base                                | 40.48 |  54.74 |  50.28 |    26.07 |
| S1_dinov2_frozen                       | 40.66 |  61.01 |  45.66 |    24.98 |

| fitted weights, in-sample (optimistic) | 33.86 |  40.28 |  45.95 |    23.18 |
